turns.label: L01 · Longer story and expression changes · 28 seconds
turns.user: Tell me a longer story, with a wave and a few expressions.
turns.reply: *waves* *relaxes* Hey. I was thinking about that little adventure you mentioned yesterday, the one where nothing went according to plan but you somehow came home with a better story. *smiles* Really? Tell me the part you left out, especially the moment when you realized you would have to improvise instead of following the perfectly sensible plan you had prepared. *nods* *blushes* Oh. That explains the grin. I had a feeling there was more to it. Now give me a second to be impressed before I start teasing you about your definition of careful.

turns.reply: *waves* *relaxes* Dr. Ellis booked a table for 7:30 p.m. on Friday. The address is 24 Maple Street, not 42. Bring $12.50 for the tickets and leave a 10% tip if you like.
